Trace, implement and test: leetcode383 ransom note brute force

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    bool canConstruct(string ransomNote, string magazine) {
        for (char& ch : ransomNote)
        {
            auto it = find(magazine.begin(), magazine.end(), ch);
            if (it != magazine.end())
            {
                magazine.erase(it);
            }
            else return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    string ransomNote = "aa", magazine = "ab";
    auto res = sol.canConstruct(ransomNote, magazine);
    cout << (res == true ? "True" : "False") << " ";

    return 0;
}
